title: 第303章 地宗悟元子第302章 老道士
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
席一悠抬眸望他，眼底的狡黠与慵懒尽数收敛，多了几分温顺乖巧。
她轻轻点头，眉眼柔婉，语气软糯轻柔：“嗯，你万事小心些……”
话音顿了顿，她眼底再度漾起一抹浅浅的、魅惑的笑意，凑近半分，气息轻柔拂过他的耳畔，带着几分隐秘的娇俏期待：“处理完了就来落云院找我，今日我给你准备了一份惊喜……”
那声惊喜说得轻缓暧昧，尾音微微上扬，带着撩人的悬念，勾得人心尖微痒，遐想万千。
杨欢看着她眼底藏不住的风月狡黠，心底微动，猜不透她口中的惊喜是何，却还是温和颔首，轻声应道：“好……”
席一悠浅浅一笑，不再多言，身姿轻盈转身，裙摆轻轻扫过地面，步履温婉从容，径直走向席府大门。
门前清扫的下人见是她归来，纷纷垂首行礼，她目不斜视，径直踏入府门，身影很快消失在朱漆大门之内。
目送席一悠的身影彻底入府、大门轻轻合拢，隔绝了府内景致，杨欢才缓缓收回目光。
他收敛眼底所有温柔缱绻，神色归于沉静淡然，转身抬步，朝着左侧古木之下盘膝静坐的老道士缓步走去。
几步距离，转瞬即至。
在距离老道士身前三步之遥的位置，杨欢驻足停步，身姿挺拔端正，神色谦逊有礼，没有半分年少修士的桀骜，也无半分局促拘谨。
他抬手结出道门正统礼印，动作规整端庄，姿态恭敬谦和，语气温润沉稳，礼数周全：“晚辈杨欢，见过前辈。晚辈愚钝，从前未曾有幸结识前辈，观前辈气韵超然，想必是世外高人。不知前辈驻足于此，可是专程寻晚辈而来？还请前辈明示身份。”
一番问话客气自持，谦逊却不卑微，沉稳且有分寸，将晚辈的恭谨与自身的气度拿捏得恰到好处。
树下静坐的老道士闻言，平淡无波的眼底掠过一丝浅浅的赞许。
他显然十分满意杨欢这份不骄不躁、沉稳有礼的姿态。
沉默片刻，老道士缓缓躬身，佝偻的身躯慢慢直起，从地面稳稳站起身来。
他身形虽依旧佝偻，却在起身的瞬间，隐隐透出一股沉厚如山的道韵，平淡的气场骤然厚重数分。随后他抬手，同样结出一道规整老道的道家回礼，动作从容沉稳，古韵十足。
“贫道，地宗悟元子……”老道士声线低沉沙哑，语速平缓缓慢，听不出喜怒，却自带岁月沉淀的厚重感，字字落地有声。
话音落下，悟元子缓缓抬起枯瘦干瘪的右手，从陈旧发白的道袍怀中，小心翼翼取出一块残破的玉石。
那玉石体积不大，入手观感温润细腻，质地通透纯粹，绝非市井凡玉所能比拟。

只是边缘参差不齐，裂痕粗糙锋利，断面崭新清晰，明显是从一块完整的上古玉盘之上硬生生断裂拆分下来的残片。
玉石表面没有繁复纹路，没有镌刻道印，却萦绕着一层极淡、极绵长的灵力波动，微弱却纯粹，经久不散，带着古老悠远的岁月气息，隐隐透着大道底蕴。
悟元子指尖轻轻托着这块残玉，目光沉静地望着身前的杨欢，缓缓开口，“杨道友心性沉稳、礼数周全，果然聪慧通透。贫道今日专程前来，的确是为寻你……”
杨欢的目光落在那枚残破玉石之上，眸光微凝，细细感知着玉石表面残存的悠远灵力，心底疑惑更甚。
他收敛心绪，依旧保持谦逊姿态，轻声问道：“原来是地宗悟元子前辈，不知前辈专程寻晚辈，所为何事？”
悟元子并未即刻作答，只是眼底掠过一抹深浅莫测的笑意，抬手微微一扬。
下一瞬，那枚温润的残破玉石脱离他的指尖，稳稳凌空飞起，力道不急不缓，不偏不倚，径直朝着杨欢身前飞来。
杨欢心神微凛，下意识抬手，指尖稳稳探出，精准接住飞来的残玉。
玉石入手微凉，转瞬便贴合掌心温度，变得温润妥帖，触感细腻顺滑，只是握在掌心之中，看似平平无奇，没有丝毫异动，没有灵力爆发，没有道纹流转，寻常得看不出半点特殊玄妙。
他低头垂眸，细细端详掌心的残破玉片，反复感知其中气韵，依旧一无所获。
就在他暗自疑惑之际，耳畔再度响起悟元子沉缓的嗓音：“你且收好……”
“此物，是我地宗赠予小道友的一份见面礼……”
杨欢指尖轻轻摩挲着玉石粗糙的断口，眸光沉静，抬眸再度看向悟元子，语气诚恳且疑惑：“多谢前辈厚赠。只是晚辈愚昧，实在看不出此玉玄妙何在。此玉平平无奇，晚辈与地宗素无交集，不知地宗为何特意赠予晚辈这般贵重的信物？”
悟元子闻言轻轻摇头，神色淡然无波，语气平和地道：“贵重谈不上……”
他目光落在杨欢掌心的残玉上，眼底带着几分追忆与悠远，缓缓解释：“这残玉是我地宗‘尚玖盘’拆分而出的碎片。‘尚玖盘’是我地宗第一任道首的法器，后来这法器意外碎裂，尽数拆分，一共碎成九枚残片。时至今日，贫道手中自留一枚，其余八枚，其中的七枚已被我陆续送往各地，赠予了有缘之人。”
说到此处，悟元子抬眸直视杨欢，眼神笃定，语气郑重：“你手中这一枚，是最后一枚。而你，也是最后的一位有缘人……”
听完这番缘由，杨欢心底的疑惑非但没有消减，反而愈发浓重。
他看着掌心温润古朴的残玉，知晓这是地宗至宝的碎片，绝非寻常俗物可以比拟，分量极重。
他当即收敛神色，双手捧着残玉，微微躬身，姿态愈发恭谨，语气恳切推辞：“承蒙前辈看重，赐下宗门至宝机缘。只是此玉渊源深重、意义非凡，晚辈一介散修，无德无凭，实在不敢随意收下这般厚礼，还请前辈收回。”
他心中思虑分明，地宗底蕴深厚、渊源久远，这份馈赠太过沉重，二人素无交情，贸然收下，必然欠下地宗人情，日后难免纠葛不断，绝非好事，推辞乃是情理之中。
content_en:
Xi Yiyou raised her eyes to look at him, the cunning and laziness in her eyes were gone, and she became a little more docile and well-behaved.
She nodded gently, her eyebrows were soft, and her tone was soft and soft: "Well, you should be careful..."
There was a pause in her words, and a faint, charming smile appeared in her eyes again. She leaned half a minute closer, and her breath gently brushed his ears, with a bit of secret and charming expectation: "Come to me in Luoyun Court after you are done with it. I have prepared a surprise for you today..."
The sound of surprise was spoken softly and ambiguously, with a slight upward pitch at the end, and a tantalizing suspense that made people's hearts itch and make them think a lot.
Yang Huan looked at the cunning Fengyue that could not be hidden in her eyes, and her heart moved slightly. He couldn't guess what the surprise in her mouth was, but he still nodded gently and responded softly: "Okay..."
Xi Yiyou smiled lightly, said no more, turned around lightly, the hem of her skirt lightly swept the ground, and walked straight to the door of Xi's mansion with gentle and calm steps.
When the servants who were cleaning in front of the door saw that she had returned, they bowed their heads and saluted. Without looking away, she stepped straight into the door, and her figure quickly disappeared inside the red lacquer door.
After watching Xi Yiyou's figure completely enter the mansion and the door gently closing, blocking out the scenery inside the mansion, Yang Huan slowly withdrew his gaze.
He suppressed all the tenderness and affection in his eyes, his expression returned to calmness and indifference, he turned around and walked slowly towards the old Taoist priest who was sitting cross-legged under the ancient trees on the left.
Just a few steps away, you'll be there in an instant.
Three steps away from the old Taoist priest, Yang Huan stopped. His posture was upright and upright, and his expression was humble and polite. He was not a bit unruly or cramped like a young monk.
He raised his hands to form the orthodox ritual seal of the Taoist sect, his movements were regular and dignified, his posture was respectful and modest, his tone was gentle and steady, and he was polite: "Junior Yang Huan, I have met my senior. I am stupid and have never been lucky enough to get to know my senior before. Judging from my aura and aloofness, I must be an expert from outside the world. I don't know that my senior is here to stop, but he came here specifically to find my junior? Please clarify your identity, senior."
He was polite and self-possessed when asking questions, humble but not humble, calm and measured, and had just the right balance between the junior's respect and his own magnanimity.
When the old Taoist priest who was sitting quietly under the tree heard this, a hint of approval flashed across his calm eyes.
He was obviously very satisfied with Yang Huan's calm and courteous attitude.
After a moment of silence, the old Taoist priest slowly bowed, his rickety body slowly straightened up, and he stood up steadily from the ground.
Although his figure was still stooped, the moment he stood up, he faintly revealed a Taoist charm as thick as a mountain, and his ordinary aura suddenly became thicker. Then he raised his hand and formed a regular Taoist return gift, his movements calm and steady, full of ancient charm.
"Poor Taoist, Earth Sect Wu Yuanzi..." The old Taoist priest's voice was low and hoarse, and his speech was slow and slow. There was no emotion or anger in it, but it had a sense of heaviness accumulated over time, and every word fell to the ground.
After the words fell, Wu Yuanzi slowly raised his withered right hand and carefully took out a broken jade stone from the arms of the old and white Taoist robe.
The jade is not large in size. It feels warm and delicate to the touch, and its texture is transparent and pure. It is definitely not comparable to ordinary jade in the market.
It's just that the edges are uneven, the cracks are rough and sharp, and the cross section is brand new and clear. It's obviously a fragment that was broken off from a complete ancient jade plate.
There are no complicated lines on the surface of the jade, and there are no Dao seals engraved on it, but there is a layer of extremely light and long-lasting spiritual energy fluctuations, weak but pure, lasting, with the aura of ancient and distant years, and vaguely revealing the foundation of the Dao.
Wu Yuanzi gently held the piece of jade with his fingertips, looked at Yang Huan in front of him calmly, and slowly said, "Fellow Taoist Yang has a calm mind, good manners, and is really smart and transparent. I came here today to find you..."
Yang Huan's eyes fell on the broken jade, and his eyes were slightly focused, carefully sensing the distant spiritual power remaining on the surface of the jade, and he was even more confused in his heart.
He calmed down his emotions and still maintained a humble posture, speaking lightlyHe asked in a voice: "It turns out to be Senior Wu Yuanzi of Di Zong. I don't know why Senior came to find this junior. Why?"
Wu Yuanzi did not answer immediately, but an unpredictable smile flashed across his eyes, and he raised his hand slightly.
The next moment, the warm broken jade broke away from his fingertips and flew steadily into the air. It was not hurried or slow, and flew straight towards Yang Huan.
Yang Huan's heart was slightly frightened, and he subconsciously raised his hand, his fingertips steadily stretched out, and accurately caught the flying jade fragments.
The jade is slightly cool in the hand, and in an instant it fits the temperature of the palm, becoming warm and comfortable, with a delicate and smooth touch. Just holding it in the palm of the hand, it seems ordinary, with no movement, no burst of spiritual power, no flow of Dao lines, it is so ordinary that there is no trace of any special mystery.
He lowered his head and lowered his eyes, carefully examining the broken jade piece in his palm, repeatedly sensing its aura, but still found nothing.
Just when he was secretly wondering, Wu Yuanzi's deep voice sounded in his ears again: "Please put it away..."
"This thing is a gift from our Earth Sect to our little Taoist friend..."
Yang Huan's fingertips gently rubbed the rough fracture of the jade, his eyes were calm, he raised his eyes and looked at Wu Yuanzi again, with a sincere and puzzled tone: "Thank you, senior, for the generous gift. It's just that I'm ignorant and can't see the mystery of this jade. This jade is ordinary, and I have no contact with the Di Zong. I wonder why the Di Zong specially gave me such a precious token?"
Wu Yuanzi shook his head slightly when he heard this, his expression was calm, and his tone was calm and authentic: "It's not expensive to talk about..."
His eyes fell on the broken jade in Yang Huan's palm, with a hint of reminiscence and distance in his eyes, and he slowly explained: "This broken jade is the fragment of my Earth Sect's 'Shang Jiu Pan'. 'Shang Jiu Pan' is the dharma of the first Taoist leader of our Earth Sect." Later, the magical weapon accidentally broke into pieces and was broken into nine fragments. To this day, Pindao keeps one piece for himself, and I have sent seven of the other eight pieces to various places and given them to people who are destined to do so. "
At this point, Wu Yuanzi raised his eyes and looked directly at Yang Huan, his eyes were firm and his tone was solemn: "This one in your hand is the last one. And you are also the last one who is destined..."
After hearing this reason, the doubts in Yang Huan's heart not only did not subside, but became more intense.
He looked at the warm and simple residual jade in the palm of his hand and knew that it was a fragment of the earth sect's most precious treasure. It was definitely not comparable to ordinary objects and was extremely heavy.
He immediately calmed down his expression, held the broken jade in both hands, bowed slightly, his posture became more respectful, and he declined sincerely: "Thanks to the respect of my senior, I have given you the opportunity to be the sect's most precious treasure. However, this jade has a deep origin and extraordinary significance. As a casual cultivator, I have no morals and no credentials. I really don't dare to accept such a generous gift casually. Please take it back, senior."
He had clear thoughts in mind. The Earth Sect had a deep and long history. This gift was too heavy. The two had no friendship. If he accepted it rashly, he would definitely owe the Earth Sect a favor. It would inevitably lead to constant entanglements in the future. It was definitely not a good thing. It was reasonable to refuse.
